title: Operating Profit
description: Calculates operating profit and operating profit percentage. Profit is made when revenue exceeds costs. Operating Profit (OP) = Total Revenue - Total Cost. Operating Profit Percentage (OPP) = 100 × (Total Revenue - Total Cost) / Total Revenue.

components.content:
# Operating Profit

Profit is made when revenue exceeds costs.

## Operating Profit - OP

can be expressed as:

**OP = ΣR - ΣC** (1)

where:
- OP = operating profit
- R = project revenue
- C = project cost

## Operating Profit Percentage - OPP

can be expressed as:

**OPP = 100 × (ΣR - ΣC) / ΣR** (2)
